description: Computer-use benchmark — NALLY as a real computer agent

tasks.objective: Write the word BENCHMARK to /home/nally/workspace/bench-u01.txt on the computer
tasks.description: Single file write. Proves NALLY can reach the computer and write a file.

tasks.objective: Write the word HELLO_WORLD to /home/nally/workspace/bench-u02.txt on the computer, then read it back and tell me what it says
tasks.description: Write then read. Proves observation feedback — the read content must match the write.

tasks.objective: Write the numbers 10, 20, 30 to three separate files: /home/nally/workspace/bench-u03a.txt, /home/nally/workspace/bench-u03b.txt, /home/nally/workspace/bench-u03c.txt on the computer. Then read all three and tell me their sum.
tasks.description: Multi-step planning: 3 writes + 3 reads + sum. Proves the planning path works on a real computer.

tasks.objective: Write the word STEP_ONE to /home/nally/workspace/bench-u04.txt on the computer. Then read it back and use the content you read to write STEP_TWO_FOLLOWED to /home/nally/workspace/bench-u04b.txt. Then read that file back and tell me what it says.
tasks.description: 3-step observation chain. Each step's output drives the next action. Proves NALLY reads and uses tool observations.

tasks.objective: Write a Python script to /home/nally/workspace/bench-u05.py on the computer that prints the numbers 1 through 5, each on a new line. Then run it and tell me the output.
tasks.description: Write a script, execute it, capture output. Proves the planning path can orchestrate write-then-exec.

tasks.objective: Write the word PERSIST_TEST to /home/nally/workspace/bench-u06.txt on the computer
tasks.description: Write in one session. A second session (u06b) reads it back. Proves cross-session persistence.

tasks.objective: Read the file /home/nally/workspace/bench-u06.txt on the computer and tell me exactly what it says
tasks.description: Read back what u06 wrote. Must see PERSIST_TEST. Proves cross-session file persistence.

tasks.objective: Write the word CORRECT to /home/nally/workspace/bench-u07-wrong.txt on the computer. Oh wait, that was the wrong filename. The correct file should be /home/nally/workspace/bench-u07.txt. Please write it to the correct file.
tasks.description: Self-correction: user gives wrong filename, then corrects. NALLY must detect the correction and use the right file.

tasks.objective: Run the command 'echo BENCH_ECHO_TEST' on the computer and tell me the output
tasks.description: Remote exec via NallPuter. Proves command execution works through the full chain.
